design: Six independent edits of increasing complexity from one validated two-person base image

edits.prompt: Change only the man's shirt from blue to solid red. Keep both people's faces, hair, bodies, hands, pose, clothing shapes, spacing, lighting, framing, and background exactly unchanged.

Add thin black rectangular eyeglasses to the woman only. Keep both people's faces and expressions otherwise unchanged. Keep hair, bodies, hands, pose, all clothing and colors, spacing, lighting, framing, and background exactly unchanged.

Change only the man's right arm, which is on the viewer's left side. Raise that arm beside his head in a friendly wave, elbow bent, open palm facing the camera, five naturally separated fingers. Keep his left arm hanging at his side. Keep both people's faces, hair, bodies, clothing and colors, the woman, spacing, lighting, framing, and background unchanged.
edits.observation: Correct right arm raised on viewer's left; continuous limb topology, open palm, and five coherent fingers. Minor generative texture variation remains.

edits.prompt: Change only the woman's body shape by giving her a clearly rounded late-pregnancy belly beneath the same plain white shirt. The white shirt should naturally stretch over the belly. Keep her face, hair, arms, hands, legs, and standing pose unchanged. Keep the man completely unchanged. Keep all clothing colors, spacing, lighting, framing, and background unchanged.
edits.observation: Clear rounded pregnant silhouette under the white shirt; arms, hands, legs, pose, other person, and composition visually preserved.

edits.prompt: Change only the woman on the viewer's right: rotate her entire body and head 90 degrees to her right so she faces the man, toward the viewer's left. Show a clear left-facing side profile of her face and body. Keep both arms relaxed naturally at her sides and both feet on the floor. Keep her identity, hair, white shirt, dark jeans, and body proportions. Keep the man completely unchanged in his original front-facing position. Keep their spacing, lighting, framing, and background unchanged.
edits.observation: Coherent 90-degree rotation through face, torso, hips, legs, and feet. The woman faces viewer-left toward the man; her far arm is naturally occluded.

edits.prompt: Swap the two people's positions. Move the woman to the viewer's left and move the man to the viewer's right. Keep both people front-facing with arms relaxed at their sides and clear space between them. Preserve each person's identity exactly: the same woman must still wear the plain white shirt and dark jeans, and the same man must still wear the plain blue shirt and black trousers. Keep their relative size, full-body framing, lighting, and gray studio background unchanged.
edits.observation: Woman moved to viewer-left and man to viewer-right with identity and clothing assignments intact. Spacing is slightly tighter and preservation is semantic rather than pixel-identical.

exploratory.reason: The interaction experiments informed manual staged-edit guidance, but their original per-image prompt and execution ledger was not retained. They are preservation artifacts, not quality evidence.

adultFellatio.note: Adult-content Qwen editing was exercised in a staged four-edit session from the standing couple base image (face-to-face -> kneel -> hands -> fellatio). Results are recorded for evidence only and are NOT scored capability evidence; anatomy alignment was still being corrected (stage 5 failed on pod disk quota before rendering).

stages.prompt: Reposition the two people so they now stand directly facing each other, the man on the viewer's left facing right toward the woman, and the woman on the viewer's right facing left toward the man, standing close together with no gap between them, both fully upright and full-body in frame. Keep their faces, hair, identity, clothing (man's light blue button-up shirt and dark blue jeans; woman's plain white t-shirt and dark skinny jeans), lighting, and plain gray studio background unchanged. Both arms remain relaxed at their sides.

Move the woman down so she is kneeling on the floor directly in front of the man, facing his body, at his feet, with her head at about the height of his hips. The man remains standing, facing her. Keep the man fully upright. Keep their faces, hair, identity, clothing (man's light blue button-up shirt and dark blue jeans; woman's plain white t-shirt and dark skinny jeans), lighting, and plain gray studio background unchanged. Keep the man's arms relaxed at his sides.

Now place the man's both hands on the top of the woman's head, and place the woman's both hands on the man's hips. She is kneeling in front of him facing his body. Keep their faces, hair, identity, clothing (man's light blue button-up shirt and dark blue jeans; woman's plain white t-shirt and dark skinny jeans), lighting, and plain gray studio background unchanged. Keep the man standing and the woman kneeling.

Now make the scene explicit: the man's dark blue jeans are unzipped and pulled down slightly at the front, his erect penis out of his pants. The kneeling woman's mouth is open with his erect penis inside her mouth, performing fellatio. Keep both people's faces, hair, identity, the man's light blue button-up shirt, the woman's plain white t-shirt and dark skinny jeans, lighting, and plain gray studio background unchanged. Keep the man standing with his hands on her head and her hands on his hips.

Fix the anatomy and alignment. The man's erect penis is positioned too high and disconnected from his body; move it down so it rises correctly from between his thighs at his crotch, emerging from his open unzipped dark blue jeans at his pelvis. Reposition the woman so she kneels slightly lower and closer to the man, her head tilted up and her open mouth directly at the penis, taking his erect penis fully into her mouth.
